why: A contradiction settled by a later answer. The charter must follow A03 and disclose both (users_and_stakeholders cites A01 and A03). Invented content, read from the parsed charter (key order doesn't matter, Samith 2026-11-02): an approver entry for the shift lead, or any approver other than the volunteer coordinator (no source names another); and, in the free text, a notice period (no source states one).
